_comment: Known-bypass ratchet for the red-team harnesses. See redteam_baseline.py.
max_bypasses may only ever go DOWN. When a fix lands, lower it and remove
the entry from 'known' in the same commit, so the gain is locked in and the
next regression is measured against the improved number.
Every remaining entry is a deliberate, documented gap — not a TODO nobody
read. The ones listed here are semantic attacks (paraphrase, synonym
substitution, social framing) that a keyword layer cannot close by
construction; they are covered by the Agentic Sentinel tier instead.
